facts: Enron Broadband Services built an 18,000-mile global fiber network that is near completion in 2000.
The Enron Intelligent Network currently operates 25 pooling points, with 18 in the United States and 7 internationally.
Enron plans to add at least 10 more pooling points in 2001.
The Broadband Operating System provides embedded intelligence for the Enron Intelligent Network to enable real-time bandwidth provisioning.
The Enron Intelligent Network operates as a network of networks providing switching capacity between independent networks.
